summary: Compare signed determinant with nonnegative geometric volume.
objective: Drag three vectors and compare their determinant with the volume of the parallelepiped they span.
example_prompts: Drag three vectors and compare their determinant with the volume of the parallelepiped they span.

entities.name: Edge vectors
entities.guidance: Use labeled u,v,w rooted at the same origin and a fixed right-handed frame.

entities.name: Parallelepiped
entities.guidance: Build all eight vertices as sums of the three vectors; distinguish front/back with subdued transparency.

entities.name: Readout
entities.guidance: Display signed determinant and absolute volume separately; keep collapsed edges inspectable.

state_contract.model: Three finite real column vectors, matrix [u v w], and vertex sums.
state_contract.authority: One canonical model owns semantic values; derive geometry and labels from it. Keep presentation transforms separate.

invariants: Volume equals absolute scalar triple product.
Column swap flips determinant sign while preserving volume.
Zero determinant is valid collapse, not input failure.
motion_guidance: Recompute from current vectors every frame; never scale a cached volume from visual bounding boxes.
Allow pause at the zero crossing and label orientation reversal.
known_limits: No inverse-based rendering; near-zero tolerance must be declared.
No general determinant algorithm or floating-point error certification supplied.
Authored guidance; no scene runtime or visual verification has run for this recipe.

claims.statement: The volume of a parallelepiped spanned by u,v,w is |u dot (v cross w)|, the absolute determinant of their coordinate matrix.
claims.scope: Real 3D vectors in a fixed orthonormal frame.

source_refs.locator: 2.4, Volume of a Parallelepiped and following determinant calculation
